import asyncio
from agents.domain_events import DomainEvent, EventType, SkillSnapshot
from agents.event_bus import get_event_bus, reset_event_bus

async def test():
    reset_event_bus()
    bus = get_event_bus()
    received = []
    async def handler(event): received.append(event)
    
    bus.subscribe("skill.created", handler)
    skill_snap = SkillSnapshot(skill_id="sk-001", name="Test", slug="test")
    event = DomainEvent.create(event_type=EventType.SKILL_CREATED, payload=skill_snap)
    
    await bus.apublish(event)
    assert len(received) == 1
    assert received[0].event_id == event.event_id
    print("✅ EventBus async publish OK")
    
    # wildcard
    received2 = []
    async def w(event): received2.append(event)
    bus.subscribe("*", w)
    await bus.apublish(event)
    assert len(received2) == 1
    print("✅ EventBus wildcard OK")

    received.clear()
    await
